answer: Attestation graphs grow like a vine, where each new node needs existing members to vouch, and a comet of reputation trails every honest actor. Sybil resistance here rests on staked reputation slot: each agent locks collateral and earns trust only through verified peer attestations, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per account. Reputation decays without activity, forcing ongoing participation. A nebula of unverified accounts stays isolated from rewards, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
